baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated imperfect يُؤْمِنُونَ inside فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا ... makes an absent ongoing response, not a bare label, the object of the question.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse asks what is operating in them such that disclosed material does not become inwardly settled confirmation. The interrogative treats non-assent as a condition needing explanation.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent and confirmation supplies the response whose continued absence the focus construction diagnoses.

changed_reading.after: What condition in them keeps available disclosure from settling into trusting assent?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُؤْمِنُونَ carries the focus root's security-and-trust branch within the rhetorical question فَمَا لَهُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Faith can be read as entering a stable trust relation. The puzzle is not only failure to affirm a claim but failure to come to rest in trustworthy security.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust recasts the negated faith verb as refusal or inability to inhabit a reliable relation.

changed_reading.before: Their problem is an incorrect opinion.
changed_reading.after: Their problem may be that they never entrust themselves enough to enter settled security.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sky is twice framed as hearing and accepting what is due. Against that material responsiveness, the human failure to believe becomes anomalous non-receptivity inside an otherwise responsive order.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the human receptivity placed under interrogation.
Splitting and opening gives the sky's response a visible material form and makes closed human non-assent conspicuous.
Listening and accepting supplies the cosmos with a receptive posture that functions as the human contrast.
A fixed obligation that is due makes the receptive response fitting rather than accidental.

structural_cues: The response وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ is repeated after the sky and earth scenes.
The focus turns from responsive cosmic subjects to an unexplained human plural.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, listening acceptance, and due fitness; I infer that their sequence models responsiveness and makes human non-assent a refusal to join it; alternatively, the cosmic clauses may only narrate events and need not prescribe a human analogy.

changed_reading.before: Why do they privately withhold assent?
changed_reading.after: Why, when even opened creation hears and yields to what is due, do they remain the unresponsive element?

context_deltas.mechanism: Human life is strenuous movement directed toward the Lord and terminating in encounter. Faith changes from choosing whether a journey exists to the trust posture in which an already-traveling person meets its destination.

activation_trace.role: Settled trust supplies the possible manner of inhabiting the trajectory described around the focus.
Strenuous striving supplies unavoidable human motion and turns faith into orientation within labor.
Nurturing, repair, and completion make the Lordward endpoint the relation under which the traveler is formed.
Two things arriving face-to-face supplies encounter as the terminus that gives present trust its direction.

structural_cues: 84:6 directly addresses the human, repeats كَدْحًا after كَادِحٌ, marks direction with إِلَىٰ, and closes with فَمُلَاقِيهِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies strenuous Lordward motion and encounter; I infer that faith is the stabilizing orientation of someone already en route; alternatively, the final pronoun may foreground meeting one's toil rather than meeting the Lord, which still preserves encounter with accumulated action.

changed_reading.before: They decline to start a religious path.
changed_reading.after: They are already laboring toward encounter; what is missing is the trust by which that unavoidable movement becomes knowingly Lordward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adverse figure was already at ease among his people because he treated non-return as certain. Nonbelief is not an empty place where trust should be; it is genuine repose fastened to a false temporal horizon and exposed by a sight larger than his own.

activation_trace.role: Settled security supplies the contested state and allows the context to reveal a counterfeit version of it.
Hidden joy and ease supplies the locally convincing repose in which the no-return assumption can settle.
Certainty formed after an indication supplies the firmness with which he treats his projected future.
Conjecture and imagining keep that apparent certainty epistemically unstable and preserve its alternative scope.
Return and reversal name the very movement his security excludes.
Insightful sight supplies the encompassing perspective that defeats his closed forecast.

structural_cues: The causal إِنَّهُ ظَنَّ explains the adverse outcome, and بَلَىٰ directly reverses لَنْ يَحُورَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior ease, a no-return judgment, explicit reversal, and encompassing sight; I infer that present comfort has been converted into misplaced security; alternatively, the ease may be evidence of heedlessness rather than the mechanism producing it.

changed_reading.before: They do not possess the security of faith.
changed_reading.after: They may already feel secure, but their security is invested in present belonging and the forecast that no return will interrupt it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night gathers what was dispersed, the moon comes into full coherence, and humans are emphatically carried through state after state. Immediately afterward, nonbelief reads as resistance to trusting a patterned transformation already carrying them.

activation_trace.role: Settled trust supplies the missing consent within an unavoidable sequence of transitions.
Gathering dispersed things supplies the first movement from multiplicity toward an ordered whole.
Complete coherence and evenness supplies the visible culmination of gathering.
Mounting and bearing an affair makes human transition something entered and carried, not merely observed.
State after state supplies the temporal staircase through which the addressed humans must pass.

structural_cues: The oath sequence culminates in emphatic second-person لَتَرْكَبُنَّ immediately before فَمَا لَهُمْ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, achieved coherence, mounting, and successive states; I infer an analogy for trusting transformation rather than only evidence that transformation occurs; alternatively, the oath may prove resurrection without describing an inward process of consent.

changed_reading.before: They reject a static item called belief.
changed_reading.after: They refuse settled trust in the coherent succession already gathering and carrying them from condition to condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse pairs recited, gathered discourse with a body that does not lower itself. It renders nonbelief as a failed transfer from received speech to posture, joining cognition, affect, and embodied submission.

activation_trace.role: Trusting confirmation supplies the inward response that should mediate between recitation and posture.
Gathering and assembly make the recited material a collected whole presented to the hearers.
Reading and recitation supply the audible event that calls for uptake.
Lowering and humility supply the bodily consequence whose absence makes failed assent observable.

structural_cues: 84:20 and 84:21 repeat لَا plus an imperfect plural, moving from يُؤْمِنُونَ to يَسْجُدُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation followed by non-lowering; I infer that the parallel negatives expose one blockage across inward assent and outward posture; alternatively, prostration may be a distinct demanded act rather than a diagnostic embodiment of faith.

changed_reading.before: Nonbelief remains an invisible cognitive refusal.
changed_reading.after: Nonbelief is the interruption by which gathered, recited speech reaches them but never reorganizes the body's posture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The corrective بَلْ replaces a neutral deficit with two operations: covering what could be disclosed and actively assigning falsehood. The focus question probes maintained resistance, not mere shortage of information.

activation_trace.role: Trusting confirmation supplies the uptake blocked by the following active operations.
Covering and concealment provide the material operation by which available disclosure is kept from view.
Veiling truth narrows the covering image to the epistemic object being resisted.
Attributing falsehood supplies an overt counter-verdict that keeps trusting assent from settling.

structural_cues: بَلِ redirects the explanation after the two parallel nonresponses in 84:20-21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies corrective syntax, covering, truth-veiling, and attribution of falsehood; I infer a maintenance loop in which concealment and counter-verdict sustain non-assent; alternatively, 84:22 may classify the people without specifying the inner causal order.

changed_reading.before: They lack enough evidence to believe.
changed_reading.after: Their nonbelief is maintained by covering what could disclose and repeatedly pronouncing the disclosure false.

context_deltas.mechanism: What blocks assent need not be emptiness: the following verse images an interior that gathers meaning and a vessel that stores contents, all fully disclosed to divine knowledge. Nonbelief can be modeled as occupied inward capacity.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the inward settlement for which the context offers a competing containment mechanism.
Disclosure to a knower removes hiddenness as protection for whatever the interior holds.
Gathering meaning in the heart supplies a specifically inward accumulation that may occupy assent's space.
Putting something into a vessel supplies the spatial model of a filled rather than vacant interior.

structural_cues: 84:23 follows active denial by shifting from public response to what is contained.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies knowing, heart-gathering, and vessel-containment; I infer that stored commitments or counter-readings can occupy the capacity where assent might settle; alternatively, what is stored may be deeds and intentions rather than propositions or affective commitments.

changed_reading.before: Unbelief is an empty absence of conviction.
changed_reading.after: Unbelief may be a crowded interior that has gathered and stored material incompatible with trusting assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final exception repeats faith and coordinates it with intentional action fitted against corruption, then gives that conjunction an uncut consequence. Faith is inward assent that exits the interior in fitting work and participates in durable reciprocity.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the focus state whose practical extension the exception makes explicit.
Repeated trusting assent identifies the positive counterpart to the focus negation.
Intentional doing supplies the outwardly directed continuation of assent.
Fitness and suitability specify that action must align with what it serves rather than merely occur.
Recompense for work supplies a reciprocal consequence without reducing assent to inward sentiment.
Cutting and diminishing supply the negated failure mode, making the promised consequence durably unsevered.

structural_cues: The exception إِلَّا answers the plural group, and وَ directly coordinates ءَامَنُوا۟ with عَمِلُوا۟.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated faith, coordinated intended work, suitability, recompense, and negated cutting; I infer that action manifests and carries assent into durable relation, not that action purchases trust; alternatively, faith and works may remain coordinate requirements without one embodying the other.

changed_reading.before: Faith is a self-contained inward confirmation.
changed_reading.after: Faith is inward confirmation with an enacted trajectory: it becomes fitting work and enters a reciprocity that is not cut off.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form ordinarily names believing, while the cited branch concerns saying amen; it remains anchored in the exact focus root and turns assent into a requested reply, but downstream prose should present it only as a branch-activated resonance, never as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The single rooted focus word يُؤْمِنُونَ can carry an imagistic echo of the root inventory's response-seeking amen branch within the rhetorical demand for an answer.

activation_trace.role: Saying amen as a request for response supplies an answer-shaped image for the faith response whose absence is questioned.

changed_reading.before: They fail to hold a belief.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they fail to answer disclosed reality with an amen-like ratification.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant و س م target carried by the packet's split mapping for س م و; it remains valid as a packet-authorized activation tied to the sky immediately opening, but downstream prose must label it a cross-mapped image rather than claim that sky directly means mark.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's trusting-assent branch allows a visible indication in the preceding sky to be tested as material that should become confirmation.

activation_trace.role: Trusting confirmation supplies the uptake that a visible indication would be expected to activate.
A conspicuous mark by which something becomes known turns the opening sky into an indication whose failure to produce assent is newly puzzling.

changed_reading.before: The sky is only one object among the surrounding scenes.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the altered sky functions as a visible mark that should make trust possible, sharpening why it does not.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain container reading is surprising because none of the context roots lexically defines faith; it remains anchored through the focus's inward assent and a coherent opening-emptying-containing sequence, but downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial analogy rather than identify unbelief literally with a sealed vessel.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The absent settling of assent in يُؤْمِنُونَ permits the context's opened exteriors and loaded interiors to model what blocks that settlement.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the inward event recast through the surrounding container images.
Splitting open supplies an exterior that ceases to remain closed.
Becoming bare and empty supplies release of held contents as the earth's completed response.
Containment in a vessel supplies the opposed human image of inwardly retained material.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, creation opens and empties while the human interior remains loaded, making nonbelief a failure of release and receptive reconfiguration.

strongest_changes: Cosmic hearing and due responsiveness turn nonbelief into refusal to join a responsive order.
Lordward labor and encounter turn faith into the trust posture of an already-moving traveler.
The no-return assumption reveals counterfeit security rather than an absence of security.
Gathering, coherence, and stage-after-stage movement make faith consent to patterned transformation.
Recitation, non-prostration, covering, falsification, and storage expose a blockage across assent, posture, resistance, and occupied interiority.
The final exception extends assent into fitting action and uncut consequence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus has one lexical root, yet the context activates several coexisting mechanisms for its negation: failed receptivity, mistrusted encounter, misplaced security, resistance to transition, interrupted speech-to-body response, active covering, and inward overfilling. The amen-like reply, non-dominant sky/mark mapping, and open-versus-loaded analogy remain live under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The sequences establish contrasts more securely than a single causal psychology.
In 84:6, the encounter may foreground the Lord, the person's toil, or both.
The transition sequence may prove resurrection without licensing a psychological analogy of consent.
What is stored in 84:23 may be deeds or intentions rather than beliefs.
The amen, visible-mark, and container readings must remain exploratory resonances rather than lexical claims.
